info.title: Crew core integration API
info.description: Bounded core integration surface. This document is not the complete Crew API. See x-excluded-routes for the current v1 routes outside its scope. UTF-8 byte bounds and control-character restrictions are enforced by the shared runtime schemas and described with x- extensions.

instructionPacks.description: Instruction pack UUIDs in model reading order, each once.
Instruction pack UUIDs in model reading order, each once.

CommandUnavailable.description: The command outcome is unknown. Reconcile the original identity; retry_same_request requires the same request.

post.description: One admission attempt. Preserve requestId and exact UTF-8 text for reconciliation. Acceptance does not prove completion or effects.
Durable cancellation intent. Delivery, native termination and effects are independent facts. This does not claim rollback.

Official AG-UI snapshot and bounded event tail. threadId must match conversationId. messages, tools and context must be empty, state and forwardedProps empty or null, and resume absent or empty. Reconnect with a fresh snapshot after cursor expiry. This route never submits work.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: If supplied, must equal the current snapshot cursor as a decimal string.

200.description: AG-UI Server-Sent Events encoded by @ag-ui/encoder 1.0.4. Each data frame is an official AG-UI event; optional id is the persisted cursor.
